content.short: Meow is a US business banking platform with treasury yield, corporate cards and USDC and USDT payment rails.
content.description: Meow is a US business banking platform focused on helping companies earn more on their cash while running everyday finance. It offers business checking with no wire or ACH fees, a Commercial Paper Account paying yield close to 4 percent, corporate cards with cashback, invoicing, spend management, international payments and crypto rails using USDC and USDT. Meow leans into AI-native businesses, letting agents open and manage accounts through tools like Claude or ChatGPT, and it supports more than 50 currencies across many regions. Banking services are provided by partner banks including Cross River and Grasshopper, giving finance teams a place to make idle cash work while managing spend.
